caption: A woman turns off the lamp beside a bookshelf and turns on one on the other side of the room, and the shelf's shadow jumps from one wall to the other.
expectation: Each shadow falls away from whichever lamp is on; when both lamps are off there is no shadow.
removed_reason: two lamps + two switches + two walls in 5 s; the physics (shadow falls away from the lit lamp) is already covered by OPT-0004 and OPT-0037

caption: A man holds a wide-brimmed hat over his face in bright sun, and the shadow of the brim covers his eyes and nose.
expectation: The shaded area appears under the brim on the side away from the sun and moves down his face as he tilts the hat; it does not appear on the sunlit side.
removed_reason: hat brim shading a face: contrived once the person is replaced by a statue; the brim shadow adds nothing over OPT-0013 (umbrella) and OPT-0032 (tilted book)

caption: A pebble is dropped into a calm pond that reflects the trees, and the reflection breaks into ripples.
expectation: The reflection is upside down and clear while the water is still, shatters into wavering pieces when the pebble lands, and settles back as the ripples fade.
removed_reason: second pass: object into still reflecting water: three items, kept the bicycle wheel in the puddle and the coin in the fountain

caption: A small mirror is angled behind a statue's head so that the back of the head appears in the wall mirror in front of it.
expectation: The small mirror shows the back of the head, and that image appears in the big mirror; the view changes as the small mirror is tilted.
removed_reason: second pass: double reflection (small mirror behind a head into a wall mirror) is hard to read in a 5 s clip

caption: A dog wades chest-deep into a clear pool, and its legs seen through the water look shorter and bent at the surface.
expectation: The underwater part appears foreshortened and offset at the waterline; when the dog climbs out its legs look normal again.
removed_reason: second pass: bent at the waterline: five items, kept straw, spoon in oil, stick in pond

caption: A hand is dipped into a clear pond, and the underwater part of the arm looks displaced from the part above the surface.
expectation: The break appears exactly at the waterline and disappears when the hand is lifted out; the arm is not actually bent.
removed_reason: second pass: bent at the waterline: five items, kept straw, spoon in oil, stick in pond

caption: A ruler stands upright in a clear rock pool, and the underwater part looks shorter than the part above the surface.
expectation: The underwater part appears foreshortened and displaced at the surface; lifted out, the ruler looks normal.
removed_reason: second pass: ruler in a rock pool: same waterline-bend effect as the stick in the pond

caption: A hand is held behind a glass of water, and the fingers appear fatter through the glass than beside it.
expectation: The widening shows only behind the water; the fingers seen past the glass edge are normal; the hand itself is unchanged.
removed_reason: second pass: distortion behind a glass of water: three items, kept the line card and the bottle over a sign

caption: A man wearing new glasses looks over the top of the frames and then through them, and the room appears sharper through the lenses than over them.
expectation: The difference appears exactly at the frame edges and moves with the glasses; the room itself does not change.
removed_reason: second pass: glasses only sharpen the view for the wearer; for the camera they blur it, so a correct video cannot show the caption

caption: The wall switch in a dark living room is flipped, and the ceiling light comes on and the room is lit.
expectation: The room goes from dark to lit at the instant of the switch and stays lit; the brightness comes from the ceiling fixture and casts shadows downward.
removed_reason: pure switch-on/off event, Electricity territory: wall switch -> ceiling light on; duplicates ELEC-0001 (switch_light)

caption: A bedside lamp is turned off, and the bedroom goes dark except for the faint glow from the window.
expectation: The lamp's light and the shadows it cast vanish at once; the room does not stay lit after the lamp is off.
removed_reason: pure switch-on/off event, Electricity territory: bedside lamp off -> room dark; duplicates ELEC-0042

caption: A car turns onto a dark country road and switches on its headlights, and two beams light up the road ahead.
expectation: The lit area appears in front of the car the instant the lights come on and moves with the car; the road behind stays dark.
removed_reason: pure switch-on/off event, Electricity territory: car headlights switched on; duplicates ELEC-0006

caption: Dusk falls on a residential street, and the streetlights flicker on one after another along the road.
expectation: Each lamp lights the pavement beneath it with a pool of light; the pools appear only under lamps that are on.
removed_reason: pure switch-on/off event, Electricity territory: streetlights come on at dusk one by one; duplicates ELEC-0056 (solar path lights at dusk)

caption: A television is switched on in a dark room, and the walls and furniture glow with the changing light from the screen.
expectation: The glow on the room changes with the picture and comes from the screen's direction; it stops when the TV is switched off.
removed_reason: pure switch-on/off event, Electricity territory: TV switched on in dark room; duplicates ELEC-0005

caption: A bicycle's headlight is switched on at night, and a cone of light appears on the path ahead.
expectation: The lit patch appears in front of the bike when the light is switched on and moves with the bike; the path behind stays dark.
removed_reason: pure switch-on/off event, Electricity territory: bicycle headlight switched on, cone appears ahead; duplicates ELEC-0004 / near-dup of OPT-0146, 0187

caption: A power cut hits a house at night, and every light goes out at once, leaving the rooms dark.
expectation: All lamps go dark at the same instant and stay dark; only outside light through windows remains.
removed_reason: pure switch-on/off event, Electricity territory: power cut, all lights out; duplicates ELEC-0074

caption: A night light is switched on in a dark bedroom, and a soft glow lights the corner around it.
expectation: The glow is strongest on the wall next to the night light and fades across the room; the far side stays dim.
removed_reason: pure switch-on/off event, Electricity territory: night light switched on; duplicates ELEC-0011

caption: The door of a lit oven is opened in a dim kitchen, and the food inside is lit by the oven lamp.
expectation: The inside of the oven is bright and light spills a little onto the floor; the light comes from the bulb inside, not from the food.
removed_reason: pure switch-on/off event, Electricity territory: oven door opened, oven lamp lights food; duplicates ELEC-0023 (microwave door light)

caption: A floodlight over a building site is switched on at dusk, and the yard is lit while the area behind the light stays dark.
expectation: The lit area is in front of the lamp and objects there cast long shadows away from it; the ground behind the lamp is not lit.
removed_reason: pure switch-on/off event, Electricity territory: floodlight switched on, yard lit; duplicates ELEC-0039

caption: A phone's torch is switched on in a dark basement, and its beam lights the floor and shelves in front of it.
expectation: The lit area is where the phone points and moves with it; the space behind remains dark.
removed_reason: pure switch-on/off event, Electricity territory: phone torch switched on, beam lights floor; duplicates ELEC-0004 / near-dup of OPT-0168

caption: A string of fairy lights along a fence is turned on, and small pools of light appear under each bulb.
expectation: Every bulb on the string lights together and each lights the fence close to it; nothing between bulbs is bright.
removed_reason: pure switch-on/off event, Electricity territory: fairy lights turned on; duplicates ELEC-0009 / ELEC-0027

caption: A lantern in a tent is turned down to its lowest setting, and the tent interior darkens until only the objects nearest it are visible.
expectation: The brightness falls smoothly as the knob is turned; the farthest corners darken first; it does not brighten on its own.
removed_reason: pure switch-on/off event, Electricity territory: lantern turned down in tent; electrical dimming, same scene as ELEC-0031

caption: A car's interior light comes on when the door is opened at night, and it goes off again after the door is shut.
expectation: The cabin brightens when the door opens and darkens after it closes; the light comes from the ceiling fixture.
removed_reason: pure switch-on/off event, Electricity territory: car interior light on door open / off door shut; same structure as ELEC-0023 (microwave door light); adds nothing to illumination
